summary: Capybara Classic is now your default mascot, with a new glass look for windows.
highlights: Capybara Classic is now the built-in mascot. Your other packs, deadlines and settings carry over.
The Upcoming work panel, quick add, setup panels and speech bubble have a new glass look.
macOS 26 uses Apple’s Liquid Glass. Earlier macOS versions use a translucent look.
Reduce Transparency or Increase Contrast gives you solid windows for easier reading.
